title: apricitus migrate: today's files into a library
description:
Implement `design/storage.md` §5 as `apricitus migrate --from <repo root> --to <library> [--link]` (in `apricitus-data`, exposed by `apricitus-cli`).

## Behaviour
- Recordings, Clips (+ analysis attachments; audio cloned or hard-linked), Slices, Markers, Candidates (with `legacyId`), Verdicts (`judge: "local"`), Crates, and Scores with ScoreRefs.
- A report of counts.
- Exits non-zero on any unresolved score reference.
- Idempotent: a second run reports 0 changes.

## Check
`scripts/check-migration.sh` migrates to a temp library, then for each `examples/*.apr|yaml` renders it from the files (`apricitus render`) and from the library (`apricitus render --library <lib>`), and `cmp`s the WAVs.

## Verify
```
apricitus migrate --from . --to /tmp/apr-lib --link     # report
apricitus migrate --from . --to /tmp/apr-lib --link     # "0 changes"
scripts/check-migration.sh                              # all identical
```
